recap.headline: Gopher Gold Runs the Town
recap.subhead: Gopher Gold owned last night; Adam Silver Dez Nuts would like it struck from the record.

zingers.line: Worst box score in the league last night. Twelve teams, and you found the bottom.
Best night in the league, which says more about the other eleven than about you.
Beats most of the league on paper and still loses. Unlucky is one word for it.
Luckiest schedule in the league. The record is a lie and everybody knows it.
